kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننغمس (form VII)
# نَنْغَمِسُ (nanḡamisu) /nan.ɣa.mi.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْغَمَسَ (inḡamasa)
# نَنْغَمِسَ (nanḡamisa) /nan.ɣa.mi.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْغَمَسَ (inḡamasa)
# نَنْغَمِسْ (nanḡamis) /nan.ɣa.mis/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْغَمَسَ (inḡamasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
